name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Judge blocks Trump's latest effort to narrow birthright citizenship
changes.summary: A federal judge has temporarily blocked a Trump executive order that would prevent certain people from automatically becoming U.S. citizens at birth.

changes.title: China's Xi visits Egypt for the first time in a decade
changes.summary: Xi Jinping's visit to Egypt for the first time in a decade, and during the Iran war, comes as U.S. allies broaden their security ties.

changes.title: U.S.-Israel relations are on the rocks ahead of elections
changes.summary: Relations between the Trump administration and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have turned rocky since Trump called a truce with Iran. Trump seeks progress in Gaza, but Netanyahu is taking a defiant stance ahead of an election.

changes.title: Xi visits Egypt as China seeks deeper influence across the Mideast
changes.summary: China's President Xi Jinping visits Egypt this week for the first time in a decade. The trip illustrates China's growing ambitions at a time when U.S. influence has been weakened by its war in Iran. (Image credit: Xie Huanchi).

changes.title: Critics question legality of Venezuela oil deals
changes.summary: Chevron's $7 billion Venezuela bet deepens U.S. ties to the country's oil industry. Critics say the deal poses risks to democracy and could fuel discontent over Washington's embrace of the government.

changes.title: Study reveals distinct patterns across single-, multi-, and mass homicides
changes.summary: An updated analysis of U.S. homicide data has found that intimate partner violence (IPV) often precipitates mass homicide and is also frequently associated with multi-victim and single-victim deaths. changes.title: In Small Iranian Town, a U.S. Attack Turns a Wedding Into a Tragedy
changes.summary: The bomb that hit the residential area was American, according to a weapons expert and a visual analysis by The Times. It killed five people and wounded 67 others, the Iranian authorities said.

changes.title: Inside the Fight Against a Flesh-Eating Fly in Mexico
changes.summary: For the first time in a year, the U.S.-Mexico border partly reopened to cattle imports following a screwworm infestation across the region. The battle against the flesh-eating fly has only just begun deep in Mexico.

changes.title: Chevron Expansion in Venezuela Extends U.S. Influence Over Oil Riches
changes.summary: The U.S. energy giant, which stayed in the country after other Western companies left, will invest $7 billion in the country to more than double its production there.

changes.title: Plane carrying Mullin makes emergency landing after engine failure
changes.summary: "The United States Coast Guard pilots made the single engine landing feel routine. No panic, just straight professionalism," Mullin said on X.
